name: v2.2.6
body:
## What's Changed

### New Features 🎉

* feat(loader): support buildInfo custom fields in parallel loaders by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15629

### Performance 🚀

* perf: streamline SplitChunks candidate preparation by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15691
* perf(loader): track loader dependencies with sets by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15659
* perf(watch): defer internal Watchpack timestamp collection by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15686
* perf: replace BigUint with FixedBitSet in code splitter by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15712
* perf: use SsoHashSet for small module chunk memberships by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15731
* perf: vectorize CSS string and URL scanning with memchr by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15738

### Bug Fixes 🐞

* fix: retain mf manifest expose assets shared with providers by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15700
* fix(core): make module source maps context independent by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15671
* fix(loader): revert native loader hook invocation by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15719

### Document 📖

* docs: update hyfdev profile links by @hyfdev-agent in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15729

### Other Changes

* test: make @rspack/test-tools a dual package by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15698
* test: migrate basic test entry points to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15701
* test: migrate config, compiler, HMR and cache entries to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15703
* test: migrate watcher test entries to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15706
* test: migrate lifecycle child scripts to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15707
* test: migrate request rewrite E2E loaders to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15708
* test: migrate recovery and CSS HMR loaders to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15709
* test: support ESM test configs and migrate initial fixtures by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15714
* chore(build): enable rspack runtime mode for rslib builds by @Timeless0911 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15715
* test: remove obsolete webpack config support by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15716
* test: migrate standalone suite configs to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15721
* test: migrate asset, loader and hook configs to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15722
* test: migrate remaining test configs to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15724
* test: migrate test configs and filters to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15725
* test: migrate expectation files to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15726
* test: migrate test definitions to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15727
* test: enable supported cases and capture ESM HMR snapshots by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15732
* chore: exclude test outputs from JavaScript language service by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15733
* test: use rspack.sources in test cases by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15734
* test: migrate remaining test configs and common helpers to ESM by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15739
* ci: migrate CodSpeed simulation runner by @hardfist in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15710

## New Contributors
* @hyfdev-agent made their first contribution in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15729

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/compare/v2.2.5...v2.2.6
